name: Juliaca

queries.query: Juliaca Peru official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party results identified SUNARP's official Base Gráfica Registral viewer, the official SUNARP Juliaca registry office evidence, and the Municipalidad Provincial de San Román PDU page with a public ArcGIS zoning service. No public anonymous parcel layer was established.

queries.query: Juliaca Perú catastro parcelas mapa oficial municipalidad SUNARP
queries.result: First-party results identified SUNARP's BGR service and the Municipalidad Provincial de San Román PDU/Visor de zonificación. The exposed ArcGIS layer is urban zoning, not a cadastral parcel service; no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Municipalidad Provincial de San Román–Juliaca is evidenced by its official PDU page and public zoning viewer; SUNARP's official Juliaca registry office is evidenced by its 2023 resolution.
registryEvidence.basis: Official sources establish local planning and registry custody, but the public BGR viewer currently presents an access flow requiring DNI and date of issue. No anonymous cadastral parcel geometry API was verified.

requests.outcome: Official municipal PDU page returned HTML and linked the public zoning viewer/ArcGIS material. It describes planning and land-use regulation, not a parcel registry endpoint.

Official SUNARP BGR viewer did not complete within 20 seconds. No login, DNI, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification bypass was attempted. Search results describe a DNI/date-of-issue access flow; no parcel request was made.
Official/public ArcGIS service metadata returned one polygon layer, p_211101_zonificacion, in EPSG:32719. Service description identifies it as Juliaca urban zoning, not cadastral parcels.

Layer schema returned OBJECTID as the system-maintained unique ID plus fields including id_lote and id_manzana; the bounded response showed those lot/block fields blank. The layer is zoning geometry, so its IDs were not treated as parcel identities.
Anonymous where=1=1 query with returnGeometry=false and resultRecordCount=3 returned three zoning attributes. No parcel geometry was retained.
Exact WUP-point query against the zoning layer returned count 0. This is not a parcel hit/miss and is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence; the exact point was preserved and not shifted.
Broad bounded Juliaca-area query returned 10,415 zoning features. This establishes only zoning coverage in the queried extent, not parcel coverage or citywide completeness.
